label: phyllopodium
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a rhizome (PO:0004542) that is a short, persistent, stalk-like outgrowth to which the stipe of a fern leaf is articulated, and which remains on the rhizome after the leaf falls, as in Polypodiaceae and Oleandra.
reason: In fern glossaries and floras (e.g. Flora of China), phyllopodia are outgrowths of the rhizome to which the stipes are jointed. The current text puts the structure 'at the base of a fern leaf' and leaves it with no bearer. part_of should be rhizome (PO_0004542). The text also lacks PO identifiers.

label: supra-alar cell
reason: Matches moss glossary usage: the cells just above the alar cells at the basal leaf margin, often differentiated from the other laminal cells. The text has the genus and differentia and cites its identifiers.

label: outer ligule
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a leaf (PO:0025034) that is a rim or fringe of tissue on the abaxial side at the junction of the leaf sheath (PO:0020104) and the leaf lamina (PO:0020039), opposite the ligule (PO:0020105), as in bamboos and some other grasses.
reason: Meaning is correct (outer ligule = contraligule of bamboos). Only change: the text now cites PO identifiers, like the other rows.

label: mesochile
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of an orchid labellum (FLOPO:0980978) that is the middle of three successive segments of the labellum, lying between the hypochile (FLOPO:0986030) and the epichile (FLOPO:0986029).
reason: Meaning is correct. 'Tripartite' can be misread as three lobes side by side. The mesochile is the middle segment from base to tip, not a side lobe. The text also lacks identifiers.

label: seed wing
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a seed (PO:0009010) that is a thin, flat, membranous outgrowth that aids wind dispersal, formed from the seed coat (PO:0009088) or, in conifers, from tissue of the ovuliferous scale (PO:0009027) that stays attached to the seed.
reason: Meaning is correct. The text lacked its genus and identifiers. 'Stays attached' explains why the conifer wing counts as part of the seed even though it comes from the scale.

label: lignotuber
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a stem (PO:0009047) that is a woody swelling at the stem base, at or below ground level, bearing many dormant buds and storing food reserves, from which the plant resprouts after fire or cutting, as in many Eucalyptus.
reason: A lignotuber is a swollen region of the stem base, not a whole shoot axis. Making it a shoot axis that is part of a stem (itself a shoot axis) is inconsistent. In PO, portions of a stem, such as shoot axis internode, are cardinal organ parts. Botanical meaning and synonyms are fine; 'burl' is rightly only a related synonym, since trunk burls also occur above ground.

label: calyx limb
definition: A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) composed of the distal portions of the sepals (PO:0009031) of a fused calyx (PO:0025582), above the calyx tube (FLOPO:0986011).
reason: Correct, and modelled on corolla limb (FLOPO:0986012). The final list 'entire, truncate, toothed or lobed' gives the limb's possible qualities, not what defines it, and should go. Consider making calyx limb and corolla limb subclasses of perianth limb (FLOPO:0986104), as calyx tube is of perianth tube.

label: floral disc lobe
reason: A clear genus-differentia definition with the right bearer, floral disc (FLOPO:0986025). It is used like the other 'lobe' classes.

label: vaginant lamina
reason: The class and definition are correct (the sheathing duplicate base of Fissidens leaves). The problem is the exact synonyms 'vagrant lamina' and 'vagrant laminae': they are misspellings (OCR or typo) and do not fit as exact synonyms. Drop them, or keep them only as hidden text-mining labels.

label: involucre lobe
reason: Correct for the fused involucres of Euphorbia (cyathium), Nyctaginaceae and Eriogonum. The 'tooth' synonyms are acceptable.

label: stamen fascicle
definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that is part of an androecium (PO:0009061) and consists of a group of stamens (PO:0009029) borne together and usually connate at the base of their filaments, as in Hypericaceae, Clusiaceae, some Myrtaceae and Malvaceae s.l. (e.g. Tilia, Bombacoideae).
reason: Requiring connate filaments is too narrow: floras use 'stamens in fascicles' for groups that are only close together (e.g. Tilia, Dilleniaceae). Also, typical Malvoideae have a single staminal tube (FLOPO:0986013), not fascicles, so the Malvaceae example needs narrowing.

label: guide cell
reason: Matches bryological usage: the deuters are large cells in a median row of the costa, between the stereid bands. The bearer and identifiers are correct.

label: stomatal line
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a single longitudinal row of stomatal complexes (PO:0002000) in the leaf epidermis (PO:0006016), as on conifer needles; several adjacent lines make up a stomatal band.
reason: Meaning is correct. Only change: the text now cites identifiers. Collective plant structure (PO_0025497) would be a more precise parent, since a line is a group of stomatal complexes, but plant structure is not wrong.

label: laminal cell
reason: The definition is correct for mosses. But the exact synonym 'leaf cells' is far too wide: as an exact synonym it would also match leaf cells of vascular plants. Make it a related synonym, or limit it to moss sources. 'lamina cells' has the same risk on a smaller scale.

label: spadix staminate zone
definition: A staminate zone of inflorescence (FLOPO:0986106) that is the portion of a spadix inflorescence (PO:0030120) bearing the staminate flowers (PO:0025600), together with the part of the spadix axis on which they are borne, as in Araceae.
reason: Overlaps FLOPO:0986106 (staminate zone of inflorescence), which already covers the spadix. It should be a subclass of that class. Its general exact synonyms 'staminate zone' and 'male zone' belong on FLOPO:0986106. Also, this text leaves out the spadix axis, but its pistillate twin (FLOPO:0986105) includes it; the two should match.

label: rostellum lobe
reason: Correct, with the right bearer, rostellum (FLOPO:0986017). The rostellum arms of Habenaria are a fitting example.

label: anther tube
reason: Correct: syngenesious anthers in Asteraceae and Lobelioideae. Its parent matches staminal tube. 'Syngenesious anthers' would fit better as a related synonym, because the word also carries the quality of being fused.

label: perianth limb
definition: A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) composed of the expanded distal portions of the perianth members of a fused perianth (PO:0025580), above the perianth tube (FLOPO:0986010).
reason: Wrong parent. A limb is formed by several fused perianth members, so it is a collective organ part structure, as corolla limb (FLOPO:0986012) and calyx limb (FLOPO:0986093) already are. A cardinal organ part belongs to a single organ. Calyx limb and corolla limb should then become its subclasses.

label: spadix pistillate zone
reason: Correct for Araceae. Pistillate flower could be cited as PO:0025599. If a general 'staminate zone of inflorescence' is kept, it needs a matching general pistillate class (for example for Typha), which would take the generic synonyms 'pistillate zone' and 'female zone'.

label: staminate zone of inflorescence
reason: Correct general class (Araceae spadix, Typha spike). It should become the parent of FLOPO:0986101 and take that class's generic synonyms. See that item.

label: emergence
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a multicellular outgrowth formed from the plant epidermis (PO:0005679) together with underlying tissue, such as a prickle (PO:0025169) or the stalked glands of Drosera, as distinct from a trichome (PO:0000282), which arises from the epidermis alone.
reason: Matches the standard anatomical definition. The new text cites identifiers and names prickle (PO:0025169), which would logically be a kind of emergence.

label: hastula
reason: Correct palm usage: a flap or crest, adaxial or abaxial, at the junction of petiole and blade. The bearer and identifiers are right.

label: aerophore
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025) of a fern that is a pale, often swollen outgrowth or line of aerating tissue at the base of a pinna or along the stipe, serving for gas exchange, as in Thelypteridaceae.
reason: Meaning is correct. The text calls PO:0009025 'fern leaf', but that identifier is 'vascular leaf'. The label and identifier must match.

label: corolla throat
definition: A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) that is the region of a fused corolla (PO:0025581) where the corolla tube (FLOPO:0985018) widens into the corolla limb (FLOPO:0986012), including the opening of the tube.
reason: Meaning is correct, but the throat is formed by all the fused petals together. It should be a collective organ part structure, like corolla limb (FLOPO:0986012), not part of a single organ. The text should also cite the tube and limb classes.

label: laesura
reason: Matches palynological and fern glossary usage: a scar on the proximal face, trilete or monolete, along which the spore opens. 'Commissure' is rightly only a related synonym.
